no force push, no deletion (nobody bypasses it)

service, scans it with Trivy, pushes it

g.text: On a merge to master: quality, then images, then terraform. Each successful images run on master
starts terraform, so the plan of the merged commit reads the images just pushed.
terraform saves the encrypted plan and applies exactly that plan after approval.
Trigger: pull requests, pushes to master
